Based on my investigation, I can see that:

1. The pods are running version 4.8.0, which was deployed last Tuesday
2. The HPA is showing "cpu <unknown>/60%"
3. The pods have CPU requests defined (1 CPU per pod)

The "cpu <unknown>" status indicates that the metrics are not being collected properly. According to the Kubernetes documentation, the HPA requires the Metrics API (metrics.k8s.io) to be available to get CPU metrics [cite: concepts/workloads/autoscaling/horizontal-pod-autoscale#support-for-metrics-apis-0]. This is typically provided by metrics-server [cite: tasks/debug/debug-cluster/resource-metrics-pipeline#metrics-server-0].

The issue likely occurred with the 4.8.0 release. This could be related to container resource metric tracking. Let me search for more specific issues around container metrics:

input.query: container resource metrics HPA specification change
